budget_bands.verdict: ~₹2.5k over — trim 1 scooty day or 2 homestay dinners

cap_note: Cap ₹20–25k for 2 people. Stay totals = room (2 share). Travel = both legs + last-mile + 2 scooty days ≈ ₹7,000–8,500 typical. Prices = Sep-2025–Aug-2026 baselines; Oct peak may run +10–20%.
disclaimer: Prices are Sep-2025–Aug-2026 baselines for 2 adults; Oct peak may run +10–20%. Confirm heater + power backup + hot water + exact balcony room at booking. Stay/place photos are representative placeholders, not actual rooms.

itinerary.title: Arrival, settle, easy walk
points: Arrive Aut 06:00–07:30 → Banjar → Jibhi by 09:00–11:00 (or direct bus 08:00–11:00)
Check in, confirm heater + hot water + balcony room + scooty contact
Afternoon: Jibhi Waterfall (₹20 entry) + Mini Thailand pool loop, 2–3 h
Evening: Hope Cafe rooftop or Forest Bean; book scooty for tomorrow

itinerary.title: Jalori scooty day
points: Start 07:00: Jibhi → Shoja (30 min) → Jalori Pass; sunrise 07:00–09:00
Pick ONE: Raghupur Fort (3 km, quieter, picnic) OR Serolsar Lake (5 km, mirror lake + temple)
Descend to Shoja: Jaani's Cafe + Rustic Cafe sunset deck; ridge walk + stargaze
Back to Jibhi by 19:00–20:00

itinerary.title: Tirthan valley day (or foot-rest day)
points: Scooty: Gushaini riverside + Chhoie Waterfall trek + Reverberate Cafe trout + GHNP Gate walk
OR foot rest: Chehni Kothi trail + Mudhouse/Forest Bean afternoon + Bleeblu dinner
Evening: OpenBook Coffee & Library or bonfire at stay

itinerary.title: Heritage + slow + catch-up
points: Whatever was skipped: Chehni / Chhoie / Serolsar, or favourite cafe + riverside
Shoja ridge if missed Monday; pack + settle bill
Confirm return taxi (Jibhi → Aut by 16:00 tomorrow)
Farewell dinner: Bleeblu or Mudhouse hostel cafe

itinerary.title: Checkout + return
points: Checkout 11:00; last cafe / waterfall-bridge walk
Taxi to Aut; board 18:00–20:30 Volvo → Delhi 05:00–08:00 Oct 9

itinerary.title: Extension — Shangarh only
points: Take +1N ONLY for the Shangarh–Sainj loop: taxi 06:00–18:00 via Aut–Larji–Sainj
Shangarh meadows + Shangchul Mahadev (no camping/alcohol/leather/loud music on meadow)
Night at Cedar Nest Sainj; Fri-evening Volvo → Delhi Sat morning
Extension cost: +1N stay ₹1,570–2,830 + ~₹500 food (+₹1,500–2,500 taxi if Shangarh)
